email.subject1: a signal play for Solutions by Text
email.body1:
Cliff, saw Solutions by Text acquired Triple Play Pay in January to expand your FinText payment capabilities.

Folding in a new product usually opens a wave of cross-sell and net-new accounts faster than the team can cover them, and that is where pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Solutions by Text off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Cliff, quick follow-up for Solutions by Text.

Post-acquisition, the revenue target usually jumps faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Solutions by Text needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Cliff, last bit of proof for Solutions by Text.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to other fintech messaging players. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Cliff, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Integrating an acquisition is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Solutions by Text either way.
